create_crystal_industry.ponder.budding_g: Vanilla budding blocks only grow when random ticks land on them. Random ticks rarely land on any one block, and even then it usually does not grow - so natural growth is barely visible.
Crystal Industry's Accelerators change this. The Electric Accelerator on the left runs on FE; the Mechanical Accelerator on the right runs on Rotational Force.
Each tick, an Accelerator forces one random tick onto every adjacent block. Growth stages that used to take minutes now take moments.
In a few seconds a fully-grown Cluster appears. Farming crystals around Accelerators becomes a fast, highly efficient way to gather them.

Some budding blocks in this mod have extra conditions - Echo needs darkness, Flammable Ice needs water, Fluix needs AE power, Quartz and Glowstone only grow at full speed in the Nether - but the growth itself is always driven by the same random ticks.
create_crystal_industry.ponder.accelerat: Accelerators come in two types: this Electric Accelerator runs on FE, while the Mechanical Accelerator runs on Rotational Force.
Supply it with FE and it activates. Every tick, it forces a random tick onto each of the six neighbouring blocks.
Random ticks drive far more than crystal growth: crops, saplings, stems - anything random-tick based will be accelerated, not only budding blocks.
And because all six sides are ticked at once, a single Accelerator can serve several budding blocks surrounding it.
Accelerators come in two types: this Mechanical Accelerator runs on Rotational Force, while the Electric Accelerator runs on FE.
Supply Rotational Force at its back - through any combination of shafts and cogs. The faster the input spins, the more random ticks it applies each second.
Every tick, it forces a random tick onto each of the six neighbouring blocks - here, two budding blocks and an ordinary wheat crop.
Running at low speed, each stage still takes a while - so far only the first advancement has happened.
Raise the input speed and the same stages complete in moments. It accelerates anything driven by random ticks - not only budding blocks, but crops and more.
With all six sides ticked at once, one Accelerator can serve several budding blocks surrounding it.
create_crystal_industry.ponder.smart_dri: This is the Smart Drill: a Mechanical Drill with two harvesting modes - Normal Harvesting and Silk Touch Harvesting.
For comparison: a regular Mechanical Drill on the left. Both drills take Rotational Force at the back and mine the block in front of the head.
In Normal Harvesting, the Smart Drill mines twice as fast as a regular drill.
Switch modes at any time through the setting slot on its side. In Silk Touch Harvesting, the mining speed matches a regular drill - but blocks drop as if mined with Silk Touch.
Budding Blocks are a special case: a regular drill - or the Smart Drill in Normal Harvesting - shatters them, and the block itself cannot be collected.
In Silk Touch Harvesting, the Smart Drill collects the Budding Block itself - one of the ways Crystal Industry lets you obtain budding blocks.
create_crystal_industry.ponder.mechanica: The Mechanical Cleaner drives the same airstream as an Encased Fan - in short, every airflow ability of the fan applies here as well.
On top of that, it is also a collector: items caught in its stream - or simply lying in front of it - are sucked in and stored in its built-in inventory.
A container placed directly in front is used in a special way: the Cleaner moves items in and out of it directly - nothing is dropped into the world.
While collecting, it can reach into that container and pull matching items straight into its own inventory.
While blowing, stored items are fed back into the container in front - again, without spilling anything into the world.
Blowing or sucking, filters, and transfer amounts are all configured through its interface and the side slot.

create_crystal_industry.configuration.ac:
Ticks between two acceleration passes.
1 = every tick (default); larger = slower.
Both accelerators scale with it, and the electric one pays its energy cost per pass.
The Goggles multiplier follows this value too.
create_crystal_industry.configuration.gl:
Chance (0.0–1.0) that a naturally generated glowstone cluster gets its lowest block replaced with glowstone budding.
0.0 = never, 1.0 = every cluster.
Whether glowstone budding also spawns a few glowstone buds/clusters on its side faces.

Number of buds/clusters spawned around each naturally generated glowstone budding block.
0 = none.

Whether glowstone buds also generate on nearby glowstone blocks around the budding block.
If false, buds only appear on the budding block's own faces.
create_crystal_industry.configuration.sc: Scan radius of the Echo Spyglass, in blocks.
Interval between two scans, in ticks.
create_crystal_industry.configuration.ma:
Maximum number of blocks returned per scan.
Prevents huge network packets from overly broad filters (e.g. stone).
create_crystal_industry.configuration.go: Overall opacity of the night vision goggles screen overlay (0.0 = invisible, 1.0 = fully opaque).
create_crystal_industry.configuration.cl:
Whether items play the fly-into-the-cleaner animation when the Mechanical Cleaner sucks them in.
Visual only: items enter the internal inventory at the same instant either way.
Mechanical Cleaner: Drops Go Straight In

Whether drops appearing inside a sucking Mechanical Cleaner's airstream go straight into its inventory instead of spawning as item entities.
Saves entities in farms; the item ends up in the same place either way.
Anything that would not be picked up right away (inventory full, filtered out, or a washing/smelting airstream) still spawns normally.
